per_credit_hour_charges.line: The models are tuition only based on 3 credit hour courses. For courses that are less or more than 3 credit hours, the tuition will be billed at $197 per credit hour with a Dual Enrollment fee of $9.55 per credit hour.

The models are tuition only based on 3 credit hour courses. For courses that are less or more than 3 credit hours, the tuition will be billed at $197 per credit hour with a Dual Enrollment fee of $9.55 per credit hour.

For courses 6-10, the student shall receive $100 per credit hour in the Dual Enrollment Grant. If the student has taken all courses with Tusculum, they shall receive the difference of tuition and the general fee in Tusculum Access Grant funding.
